name: Rubber duck
description: A yellow rubber duck with an orange beak. It floats.
notes: The reference's 0.1 g cannot be a hollow rubber duck, so the mass is 30 g, a real duck of this size; that is CHECK MASS. CHECK VOLUME: the reference's 53 ml is the rubber, while the box ratio measures the duck's outline around its hollow body.

name: Toilet brush
description: A long plastic handle with a round head of stiff bristles on a twisted wire stem.
notes: Lies along x with the bristle head at +x and a hanging ring at the handle end. CHECK VOLUME is the long, thin shape: the bounding box is mostly air around the handle.

name: Lice comb
description: A stainless steel comb with long, closely set teeth for combing lice and their eggs out of hair.
notes: Eight teeth one grain wide with two-grain gaps, so they stay apart in the iso view; a real lice comb has many more, finer and closer.

name: Comb
description: A black plastic comb, coarse teeth at one end and fine at the other.
notes: Uses the reference's 180 mm length, longer than most pocket combs.

name: Hair curler
description: A soft foam roller on a plastic core, with a hinged clip to hold a lock of hair wound round it.
notes: Foam over a plastic core; the reference lists plastic only.

name: Curling iron
description: An electric curling iron: a ceramic barrel with a spring clamp on an insulated handle. Needs mains power to heat.
notes: The cord is drawn as a short stub at the handle end. Mains-powered tools have no content field yet; it does nothing without power.

name: Dentures
description: A full set of false teeth on pink acrylic plates, upper and lower.
notes: Drawn closed together, front on +z, the upper plate with its palate. The reference's 0.1 g cannot be two acrylic plates, so the mass is 30 g, a real full set; that is CHECK MASS. CHECK VOLUME: the reference's 5 ml is the acrylic itself, while the box ratio measures the open arch. The tiles draw the white teeth grey.

name: Hair dryer
description: A hand-held electric hair dryer that blows hot or cold air. Needs mains power.
notes: Stands on its handle with the nozzle at +x. CHECK VOLUME is the pistol shape: the box takes in the space under the barrel beside the handle. Mains power and a heat output have no content field yet.

name: Hairbrush
description: A paddle hairbrush with rows of ball-tipped pins set in a rubber cushion.

name: Menstrual pad
description: A thin absorbent pad with adhesive wings. Soaks up blood.
notes: One pad laid flat and unwrapped, wings out. The reference draws it like a bandage; whether it can dress a wound is left for the medical rules, so it brings no quality here.

name: Bellows plunger
description: A plastic plunger with a T grip and an accordion bellows that squeezes air down a drain.
notes: Lies along x with the bellows at +x. CHECK VOLUME is the long handle: the bounding box is mostly air around it.

name: Toilet plunger
description: A red rubber suction cup on a wooden handle, for clearing a blocked drain.
notes: Lies along x with the open cup at +x. CHECK VOLUME is the long handle: the bounding box is mostly air around it. It could serve as a light club; a melee block is left for weapon tuning.

name: Shaving razor
description: A weighted razor handle with a three-blade cartridge.
notes: A metal-cored handle carries the reference's 110 g. The guarded blades bring no cutting quality.

name: Soap dish
description: A shallow plastic dish with ridges across its floor to let a bar of soap drain.
notes: plastic-clear-blue; the tiles draw it opaque, but it stays see-through in the game.

name: Dental floss
description: A small dispenser holding about 20 m of waxed thread, with a cutter in its lid.
notes: Drawn as the dispenser lying on its back with a tail of thread out past the cutter. The reference lets the thread be taken out for other uses; disassembly into thread needs an item for it, left for whoever drafts thread.
